narrative.overview:
Halftone Tools is a compact print-effects workshop: a warm paper desk, a proof sheet, registration marks, ink accents, and a filmstrip of process samples. The interface is intentionally flat and utilitarian. It should feel like a well-organized studio tool rather than a generic dashboard.

The visual language is neo-grotesque Swiss typography over a restrained paper-and-ink palette. Structure comes from hairlines, tonal surfaces, uppercase labels, and deliberate asymmetry between the control rail and the large proof area. The UI is dense enough for editing but leaves the proof sheet visually dominant.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with a dark ink structure.
Signal red for primary action and slot A; press mustard for secondary action and slot B.
Flat construction with hairline dividers instead of shadows or rounded cards.
Archivo for interface voice, Archivo Expanded for headings, and Space Mono for measurements and code-like values.
A persistent desktop control rail that becomes a collapsible touch-friendly drawer on phones.

rules.name: The Five-Color Chrome Rule
rules.body: Application chrome uses the named palette and its opacity/color-mix derivatives. Effect artwork may use its own user-selected inks, ramps, and separations.

rules.name: The Author-Blue Exception
rules.body: The author link is intentionally browser blue rather than an application token. It is the one approved chrome exception because the contrast draws attention to authorship and makes the credit read as a conventional external link.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo Expanded for hierarchy, Archivo for interaction, and Space Mono only when alignment or data semantics justify it.

rules.name: The Uppercase Utility Rule
rules.body: Labels, controls, metadata, and action text are uppercase with tracking. Do not apply this treatment to explanatory sentences or user-entered content.

rules.name: The Flat Proof Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and hairlines to separate regions; do not simulate depth with shadows.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structural borders and icon strokes use 1px. A 2px outline is reserved for selected filmstrip items, and a 3px marker is reserved for an active stacked pass.

dos: Do use the five named palette roles for application chrome.
Do preserve the warm paper / recessed paper / ink hierarchy in both themes.
Do use 1px hairlines for structure and 2px only for selected filmstrip emphasis.
Do use Archivo Expanded for display hierarchy and Archivo for interface controls.
Do use Space Mono for time, measurement, ASCII, and other aligned data.
Do keep the proof sheet visually dominant and preserve the complete media aspect ratio.
Do provide 44px minimum touch targets on coarse-pointer and narrow layouts.
Do keep the author link browser blue as the approved exception.
donts: Don't add shadows, rounded cards, decorative blur, or glass effects.
Don't introduce arbitrary chrome colors or replace the author-link exception with an app token.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji as interface icons; draw simple SVG geometry instead.
Don't use monospace as a generic technical costume.
Don't crop loaded media in the proof stage or allow the stage to overflow the viewport.
Don't create a new border weight without first updating this system.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Use for Export and the main Choose media action.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; font: 700 12px Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--ink); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Use for neutral actions such as Load media and Demo.
components.css: .ds-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 14px; font: 700 11px Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Use for text and select controls inside the rail.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 12px 'Space Mono', monospace; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Proof Frame
components.description: The recessed desk that holds the proof sheet and registration marks.
components.css: .ds-proof-frame { background: var(--paper-2); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; min-height: 220px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-proof-sheet { background: var(--sheet); width: 70%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border: 1px solid var(--ink); }

components.name: Effect Film
components.description: A print-sample thumbnail used to select an effect.
components.css: .ds-film { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-film-thumb { display: block; width: 118px; height: 88px; background: var(--sheet); border: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-film:hover .ds-film-thumb, .ds-film:focus-visible .ds-film-thumb { outline: 1px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-film.is-selected .ds-film-thumb { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-film-cap { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font: 400 9.5px Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
